steps.en: Install, then start it in a clone you can restore
steps.zh: 装上，在可还原的克隆里启动

steps.en: Starts the TUI, a daemon worker, and a persistent Python kernel
steps.zh: 拉起 TUI、daemon worker 和持久 Python 内核

steps.en: Authenticate a subscription or API-key provider
steps.zh: 登录订阅或填入 API key

steps.en: Give a long coding or research task
steps.zh: 丢给它一个长编码或研究任务

steps.en: The model inspects files in Python and spawns child agents in code
steps.zh: 模型用 Python 翻文件，并用代码派子 agent

steps.en: Keeps the session running after you detach; reattach later
steps.zh: 你断开后会话继续跑，之后可再挂上

value.en: You no longer stuff the whole working set into the chat window: the model programs over it, and the session survives a closed terminal
value.zh: 你不用再把整份工作材料塞进对话窗口：模型对着它写程序，关掉终端会话也还在

sources: README.md Install + Getting Started (curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL https://app.primeintellect.ai/prime-agent/install.sh | sh; cd /path/to/project; prime-agent; /login; warning that workers/kernels are not a security sandbox; prime-agent attach <agent>)
packages/coding-agent/docs/index.md (same install command; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY before launch; npm workspace names are implementation details, not the public install path)
packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md (/login subscriptions; tokens in ~/.prime/agent/auth.json; PI_OFFLINE=1 skips network model-list refresh)
packages/coding-agent/docs/rlm.md (one built-in model tool is the persistent Python kernel; rlm.spawn(...) returns an admission handle; results via agent_message or files)
packages/coding-agent/docs/architecture.md (TUI client → AgentConnection → daemon supervisor → session worker with AgentSession + Python kernel + child runtimes; workers/kernels are not sandboxes)
